# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 27 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_027_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 27

**1** "If you do not fast with respect to the world, you will not find the kingdom.

**2** If you do not observe the Sabbath as a true Sabbath, you will not see the Father."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Fast with respect to the world" — not dietary fasting but cosmic abstinence; separation from the world-system
- "True Sabbath" — not the seventh day but the deep rest of the undivided self
- The saying redeems the very practices Sayings 6 and 14 reject — but radically redefines them
- "Find the kingdom" / "see the Father" — the twin goals; discovery and vision
